theorems.name: Submission.bv_translate_sub_lintegral_le_of_fderiv
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (w : Rn n → ℝ) (Q : Set (Rn n)) (z : Rn n) (M : ℝ≥0∞), ContDiff ℝ 1 w → (∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∫⁻ y in (fun x ↦ x - s • z) '' Q, ‖fderiv ℝ w y‖ₑ ≤ M) → ∫⁻ x in Q, ‖w (x - z) - w x‖ₑ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ‖z‖ * M
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
